concepts.gloss_en: water (as a symbol of the heart / human formation from mayin dukhrin and nukvin)

members.note: representative; 'water', tied to lev/heart per Eikhah 2 proofs

concepts.gloss_en: sea (as a symbol of speech / malkhut peh, the destination of all rivers)

members.note: representative; 'sea' = dibbur/malkhut peh, distinct lexeme and referent from mayim

notes: מים (water) and ים (sea) are different Hebrew lexemes with different symbolic referents (heart/human vs. speech/malkhut). Not orthographic variants; kept separate. Mechanical 'he+clitic+plural' signal is spurious.
